eligibility.reason: E1/E4: the reporter gives sensor poses, MAVROS configuration and explicit errors; the maintainer confirms the lookup bug. E2: PX4 supplies a declared DISTANCE_SENSOR wire field consumed by MAVROS. The enum interpretation and configured-orientation check are cross-unit conditions, with an additional internal lookup defect in that composition. E3: PAIR is observed. The substantive enum-handling fix is not just a deployment-name binding or undeclared firmware fix.
eligibility.quote: You have to modify simulator code to send different orientation because mavros plugin just checks if it matches config (like sanity check).

failed_conditions.quote: DS: rangefinder_pub4: received sensor data has different orientation (CUSTOM) than in config (YAW_45)!
failed_conditions.reason: The transmitted orientation encoding is CUSTOM while the consumer expects the discrete YAW_45 representation. This supports representation_convention on DISTANCE_SENSOR.orientation. It does not establish the reporter's suspected degree/radian conversion error.

failed_conditions.quote: I found bug in enum_sensor_orientation.cpp introduced by CUSTOM entry.
failed_conditions.reason: The array lookup mishandles sparse enum value 100; the patch replaces it with a keyed map. This internal defect belongs to the same composition and the same incoming field and fits other.

loudness.quote: DS: rangefinder_pub4: received sensor data has different orientation (100) than in config (YAW_45)!
loudness.reason: MAVROS explicitly diagnoses and enforces the received/configured orientation mismatch: loud_documented.

detection_stage.reason: The errors are generated while receiving sensor data: run.

resolution.quote: I've built master and I don't get the `SENSOR: wrong orientation index: 100` message anymore. My sensor orientation is now recognized as CUSTOM and it seems to be working.
resolution.reason: This confirms improvement of the lookup condition only; the same comment still reports the YAW_45 refusal. The later CUSTOM/TF advice has no subsequent demonstrated full-composition test, and master/latest do not pin both unit revisions. Recommended is supported.

notes: The two conditions must remain separate: correcting the enum lookup does not make CUSTOM equal YAW_45. The checkid script's Python iteritems error is also visible and fixed in the PR, but is a separate diagnostic-script composition, not an additional distance-sensor condition.
